status: Power A/B/A complete; original settings restored; full triangle verified before requesting a new USB layout
purpose: Test whether changing only N2 transmit power reversibly changes original range variation

controls.physical_reboots: One per USB board per condition; journal boot generation can advance twice after SET

findings: The received-signal stimulus is visible at N3 on N2-origin poll/final frames and reverses on restoring N2 power; unchanged transmitter comparisons are comparatively stable.
The N1-N2 sample spread remains large at all three power conditions. This does not support lower N2 transmit power as the current drift fix.
N1-N2 medians also change within conditions, so whole-phase median shifts cannot safely be attributed to power.
DGC populations change across power conditions; stratified summaries are retained. Receiver-estimated RSSI does not establish a calibrated4dB radiated-power change.
N1-side response quality remains unavailable over the two current USB observers. Observing that receiver is the next missing measurement.
No fresh distance truth is assumed. These observations are about repeatability and power sensitivity, not demonstrated physical accuracy.
next_physical_action: Requested N1/N2 USB and N3 power-bank connection. Cables cannot reach with geometry fixed, so a new measured triangle was requested.

verification.harness_command_mock: Baseline/lower/restore SET commands, newline framing and full six-field recovery on both boards passed
verification.original_fields_restored: all eight identity/RF keys verified on both USB boards
